from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def timer(name):
    import time
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        print(f"{name}: {elapsed:.3f} сек")

with timer("загрузка"):
    data = load_big_data()

import tempfile
import shutil

def atomic_write(path: Path, data: str):
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        mode="w",
        dir=path.parent,
        delete=False,
        encoding="utf-8"
    ) as tmp:
        tmp.write(data)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    tmp_path.replace(path)  # атомарная замена
